description: This file defines the 'Response' class used for handling and serializing responses, including results, code, images, and page snapshots within a Playwright-based testing or automation framework.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for managing response data, including results, errors, code snippets, images, and page snapshots, with serialization capabilities.

methods.name: addResult
methods.description: Adds a string result to the response.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the response and marks it as an error.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Returns whether the response is marked as an error.

methods.name: addCode
methods.description: Adds a code snippet to the response.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the response.

methods.name: images
methods.description: Returns the list of images attached to the response.

methods.name: setIncludeSnapshot
methods.description: Flags the response to include a page snapshot.

methods.name: setIncludeTabs
methods.description: Flags the response to include tab information.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the response, capturing snapshots if needed and updating tab titles.

methods.name: tabSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the captured tab snapshot, if any.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the response into a content object, including text, images, and snapshot data.
